annotations.title: Search open calls and recent awards

description: Keyword search over the public consulting calls open now and the consulting awards of the last six months in Europe (title, buyer and winners; words match the start of words, accents ignored). Titles are in the notice's language: search in the language of the country (e.g. 'estrategia digital' for Spain) or with several languages' words. Filter by status, country, kind of work, minimum value or winning firm. Each result has the public link to its notice and a link to the same view in the radar; an open call also has its page on arquestra.dev (page), to give first. Paged: up to 25 a page, 100 a query; for a search by meaning, use the radar link.

firm.description: Only awards won by a firm whose name contains this.

kind.description: A kind of work, or the subtype procurement_advisory (advising public buyers on their tenders).

lang.description: Language of the page links (the data is the same). Default en.

query.description: Words to find (at least one word of 3 letters). All words must match; if none does, the rows matching most words are returned and marked.

via.description: Leave this out. Set only by the radar's panel (MCP App) when the person uses its filters or 'show more' (panel), or by the site owner's own tests (dev), so that use is counted apart.
